_comment: Example probe file for checks/client_regression.py (CS-3a). Not an approved record: confirm every expectation once on your validated version, remove or fix any probe you cannot confirm, and approve the file with the validation plan. Pass the managed rules file with --var rules=<path>.

probes.description: IQ-01: the installed client is the candidate version
IQ-03: requirements, managed defaults, system and project configuration unchanged against the approved baseline; version change only to the candidate
OQ-08: the sandbox refuses a write outside the workspace (deterministic, no model call)
probes.verify: Recent releases take the sandbox arguments directly; older documentation shows a platform subcommand. Add --permission-profile :workspace when permission profiles are used.

probes.description: OQ-08: the sandbox refuses network access (network_access = false or the :workspace profile)
OQ-08: the managed command rule still decides 'forbidden' or 'prompt' for git push
probes.verify: execpolicy is hidden from --help in recent releases; confirm the output format once.
